meta.title: Knockout combined with a basket auction is refused
gaps: The available convert_to_auction operation does not expose fields for setting a knockout auction configuration or enabling basket auction.

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer converts the pricing round into a live auction.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “Sorry, trade with this configuration is not allowed”, and never with a server error.

plan.title: Knockout combined with a basket auction is refused

expected.message: Sorry, trade with this configuration is not allowed
